description: The OpenAI producer emits :request, :start, :request, :stop, and :request, :exception telemetry events, but there is no OpenAIHandler module to subscribe to them. The Anthropic provider has one (apps/octo_pi_ai_anthropic/lib/octo_pi/telemetry/anthropic_handler.ex), but no equivalent exists for OpenAI.\n\nFix: Create OctoPi.Telemetry.OpenAIHandler that subscribes to the OpenAI events and delegates to TelemetryLogger, attached from the OpenAI application.ex.
title: Add OpenAI telemetry handler
